results.q: I can't upload or change my shop profile photo. What should I do?
results.a: First make sure your cellular data plan is active, or that you have access to a Wi-Fi connection with internet access. Then, try refreshing the https://www.circlesubi.id/ page in your phone's browser. If that still doesn't work contact your local Circles Support Officer.

results.q: How do I add a vendor to My Favorite Vendors list?
results.a: In the circles marketplace, you can click the small “heart’ icon to add vendors shops to your favorite list

results.q: How many different types of goods and/or services can I offer on the Circles Market?
results.a: There is no limit to the number of goods/services that users can offer through the Circles Marketplace.

results.q: Can Circles help increase visibility of my small business?
results.a: Yes, Circles can help new businesses or MSMEs to promote their businesses. First, you have to set up your business profile in the Circles application. Once created, your business will appear in the Circles Market for other users to find.

results.q: Why is my shop no longer listed on the Circles Market?
results.a:
Shops in the Circles Market may be deactivated if:

They offer any products or services that are considered to be illegal or unethical

They do not make any exchanges for 30 consecutive days

They do not provide clear information on the goods & services they offer in exchange for Circles Points




Circles shop deactivation will be carried out on an intermittent basis to maintain a user-friendly market, allowing Circles Users to easily find goods & services to exchange with Circles Points.




If you think your shop has been deactivated by mistake or would like guidance on how to amend and reactivate it, please feel free to reach out to hello@CirclesUBI.id to discuss options.




To avoid shop deactivation and be able to continue offering goods & services in the Circles Market make sure your shop has a clear offering for appropriate goods and services to exchange for Circles Points and to exchange with people in your community on a regular basis.

results.q: What is the Circles Market Shop Policy?
results.a:
The Circles Market aims to support communities of Circles Users in finding goods and services that they need to exchange for their Circles Points.




With this in mind, any shops in the Circles Market may be deactivated if:

They offer any products or services that are considered to be illegal or unethical

They do not make any exchanges for 30 consecutive days

They do not provide clear information on the goods & services they offer in exchange for Circles Points




If you think your shop has been deactivated by mistake or would like guidance on how to amend and reactivate it, please feel free to reach out to hello@CirclesUBI.id to discuss options.

results.q: I would like to reactivate my Circles Shop now, how do I do that?
results.a:
If you previously deactivated your shop, or it was deactivated by Circles due to Circles Market Shop Policy violation, once it is ready to be reactivated you can easily do so. 




Before you reactivate a shop, please first ensure it has a clear offering for appropriate goods and services to exchange for Circles Points.




To reactivate your shop, follow these steps:

From your shop account, open your PROFILE.

Choose EDIT SHOP from the menu.

Tick ACTIVATE SHOP.

results.q: Can I and my family list the same shop multiple times in the Circles Marketplace?
results.a:
Ideally, you should not list the same shop multiple times in the Circles Marketplace as it will make possible users confused about how to contact you to exchange your goods or services for Circles Points! 




It also makes the Circles Marketplace confusing to users. 




We recommend that together with your family you decide which person is the best person to hold the shop account and then the remainder of the people can simply disable the shop in their accounts.
